concerns.text: FR-001 requires retrieving data from Materials Project and AFLOWlib APIs. Task T013 implements the fetch logic, but T014 (Zenodo fallback) is marked [X] (complete) while T013 is [ ] (missing). The primary API fetch logic is missing a task implementation, leaving the core data ingestion requirement unimplemented.

FR-002 requires extracting compositional descriptors (radius, electronegativity, VEC, size mismatch). Task T016 is marked [ ] (missing) and contains the full implementation logic for these descriptors. Without T016, the feature extraction requirement is unmet.

FR-003 requires stratified splitting by alloy family. Task T018 implements this logic but is marked [X] (complete) while the task description implies it needs implementation. However, T022 (Save cleaned dataset) is marked [ ] (missing). The dataset cannot be saved/used for splitting if T022 is not implemented, breaking the data flow for FR-003.

FR-004 requires training Linear Regression and Random Forest models. Task T028 (Linear Regression) and T029 (Random Forest) are marked [X] (complete), but T025 (Load data and prepare features) is marked [ ] (missing). The training tasks depend on T025 to provide the feature matrix X and target y. Without T025, the model training requirement is unimplementable.

FR-006 requires generating feature importance rankings. Tasks T037 (Feature importance extraction), T038 (Correlation calculation), and T039 (Divergence Analysis) are all marked [ ] (missing). These are the only tasks implementing FR-006 and SC-003. Their absence means the success criterion for feature importance cannot be met.

FR-005 requires a permutation test. Task T035 implements this but is marked [X] (complete). However, T035a (Handle N < 20 case) is also marked [X] but T035's logic for N < 50 is described. The critical missing piece is T031 (Model serialization) which is marked [ ] (missing). Without T031, the trained models from T028/T029 cannot be saved for evaluation in T032/T035, breaking the FR-005 flow.

Plan Phase 0.5 (No Data Termination) requires generating `results/metrics.json` with status 'no_data' if N=0. Task T020 implements this but is marked [X] (complete). However, T013 (API fetch) is missing. If T013 is not implemented, the condition to trigger T020 (N=0) cannot be reached or verified, leaving the termination logic untested and potentially unimplemented.

Task T014 is marked [X] (complete) but the description says 'Implement Zenodo fallback fetcher... ONLY if APIs return < 50 entries'. This logic is dependent on T013 (API fetch) which is missing. The task status [X] is inconsistent with the missing dependency T013, suggesting a stale or incorrect status tag.

Task T026a is marked [X] (complete) and implements the 'Null Model' baseline. However, T025 (Load data) is missing. The baseline cannot be trained without the data loaded by T025. The [X] status on T026a is inconsistent with the missing T025.

Task T039b is marked [X] (complete) and implements Divergence Analysis. However, T037 (Feature importance) and T038 (Correlation) are missing. T039b depends on the outputs of T037 and T038. The [X] status is inconsistent with missing dependencies.
